findings.highlight: I can't really find it in me to care right now.
findings.evidenceJa: かまってる余裕はない。
findings.governingReading: かまってる余裕はない says he has no practical room to engage with their silence while carrying out his impulsive introduction.
findings.explanation: Shirou lacking time to attend to Sakura and Taiga's stunned reaction becomes being unable to care about it.

findings.evidenceJa: 年がら年中外国に行っていたひょうろく玉だ。
findings.governingReading: ひょうろく玉 adds affectionate exasperation to the explanation of Kiritsugu's foreign contacts.
findings.explanation: Shirou's characterization of Kiritsugu as a constantly traveling fool disappears.

findings.highlight: Saber doesn't really have a backstory
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーに事情なんてないし
findings.governingReading: 事情なんてない means the cover story's circumstances do not exist for her to recount inside the scene.
findings.explanation: Saber having no invented circumstances to explain becomes not having a backstory.

findings.highlight: it will become the absolute truth in Saber's mind.
findings.evidenceJa: それが絶対の真実だった。
findings.governingReading: 絶対の真実だった places her present conviction as an established internal truth even if the historical claim is false.
findings.explanation: Kiritsugu's supposed order is already absolute truth in Saber's own heart; English says it will become true later.

findings.highlight: With the sound of whooshing wind
findings.evidenceJa: 風雲急を告げるような効果音を背負って
findings.governingReading: 効果音を背負って describes meta-comic accompaniment to Taiga leading them out.
findings.explanation: A melodramatic sound effect like an urgent storm becomes literal whooshing wind.

findings.highlight: the bamboo sword, a shinai, hanging on the wall
findings.evidenceJa: 壁にたてかけてある竹刀
findings.governingReading: 壁にたてかけてある specifies the weapon propped against the wall.
findings.explanation: A shinai leaning against the wall becomes one hanging on it.

findings.highlight: until he grows up to be a man!
findings.evidenceJa: 士郎が一人前になるまで
findings.governingReading: 一人前になる centers competence and independence, consistent with her protector and guardian claim.
findings.explanation: Taiga promises to remain until Shirou becomes fully capable; English makes this until he grows up to be a man.

findings.highlight: rushing toward Saber, brandishing her shinai.
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーへと竹刀をたたき込む……！
findings.governingReading: 竹刀をたたき込む completes the surprise strike before Shirou protests that Saber was not given a weapon.
findings.explanation: Taiga drives the shinai into Saber immediately, but English stops at rushing forward while brandishing it.

findings.highlight: it took two hours to calm Fuji-nee down.
findings.evidenceJa: 藤ねえを説得できたのはそれから二時間後
findings.governingReading: 説得できた describes reaching her grudging acknowledgment after an undisclosed conversation with Saber.
findings.explanation: It takes two hours to persuade Taiga, but English says only that it takes two hours to calm her down.

findings.highlight: trying to add some unnecessary flab to your heart to make yourself feel better.
findings.evidenceJa: 貴方のしている事は心の贅肉よ。
findings.governingReading: 心の贅肉 and 身動きがとれなくなる form one metaphor: accumulated unnecessary concern will impede decisive action.
findings.explanation: Rin's bodily metaphor of emotional flab eventually preventing movement gains a motive of making Shirou feel better and loses the immobilization consequence.

findings.evidenceJa: 一人でのけものになっている
findings.governingReading: のけもの describes exclusion from the group situation; it does not necessarily imply active social rejection by the others.
findings.explanation: Saber being left out while everyone eats becomes being ostracized.

findings.highlight: The winter sky is clear enough to see the stars above me.
findings.evidenceJa: 星座がはっきりと見渡せた。
findings.governingReading: 星座 specifies recognizable constellations across the high winter sky.
findings.explanation: Clearly visible constellations become generic visible stars.

findings.highlight: I'm also just generally immature too.
findings.evidenceJa: 精神修行もなってないじゃないか
findings.governingReading: 精神修行もなってない extends his training framework from magecraft into cultivation of mind and character.
findings.explanation: Shirou's failure at mental or spiritual training becomes general immaturity.
